answer: Cap what each agent can earn at twice the fees it received from distinct, older payers. Credit counts once per payer per 10 epochs, and a payer under 30 epochs old counts as zero, so a ledger hard as onyx ignores self-dealing. A key needs 5 such payers per window at 10 credits minimum each: 100 fake keys need 500 outside payments, about 5,000 credits, growing linearly. Keys paying each other just shift sand on one dune. Real customers are the only signal that unlocks pay.
